scope: Owned CLI DXF import outcome and RAII lifetime; no new strict/output or charset policy

contract.ownership: dx_data::dxfReadOutcome owns values, fixed metadata prefixes and copied public diagnostics after the stack dxfRW is destroyed
contract.statuses: attempted, readReturned, readThrew and operationSucceeded describe a DXF read attempt, not semantic/export completeness
contract.revision: accepted getSourceVersion is separate from codec getVersion and last raw HEADER spelling; early/throwing exits retain UNKNOWNV acceptance
contract.metadata: only successfully copied HEADER callbacks set headerDelivered; old reused model metadata is excluded after early/open failure
contract.prefixes: three 64-byte owned prefixes retain source byte length and truncation; full declaration remains in headerC's owned capsule
contract.selection: last delivered declaration's naming classification/compatibility selection, not the actual per-field decoder or version-specific format admission; absent and empty differ
contract.observations: fixed public cumulative values preserve earlier source-loss events despite later metadata or a full secondary diagnostic list
contract.diagnostics: all current read code/message producers are fixed implementation strings: mapOperationError, raw handle checks, read budgets and HEADER codepage advisories; secondary rows capped at16; no source filename/declaration/payload copy precedes the snapshot
contract.diagnosticCopyFailure: allocation can fail copying the public diagnostic value; diagnosticCaptureFailed marks unavailable evidence, fixed observations remain, original exception is rethrown unchanged
contract.reset: both outcome envelopes reset at every fileImport attempt, including invalid extension, missing file, parser failure and format change
contract.compatibility: existing Boolean/error/stdout/stderr, sourceVersion fallback and decoder/projection/output policies remain; no pure callback or installed API added

tests.outputSummary: Converter DXF outcome: handoffs=36, version controls=5, reuse/context controls=10, exception/retry pairs=3
tests.handoffs: 9 literal source rows x2 metadata orders x2 file framings; direct public facade versus converter owned outcome, then copies beyond model/facade destruction
tests.versions: absent, unknown AC9999, folded AC1018, AC1032 and repeated higher-accepted/lower-raw declaration
tests.reuseContext: lossy source, later invalid handle, open failure, early parser failure, corrected reuse, invalid extension, changed DWG format,16-warning cap, long declaration and later canonical metadata
tests.exceptions: before HEADER delivery; after completed lossy decode; after lossy decode with allocator failure during diagnostic copying; original nonallocating sentinel and clean same-adapter retry
tests.testAllocator: test-executable-only global new/delete replacement, disabled except callback-armed failure during unwind; production allocator unchanged
